profile.bio: A studio statement belongs here: what you photograph, how you work, and where commissions fit. The photographs in this starter are museum Open Access samples and cannot be published as your work.

blocks.text: Statues, ponds, and hedges photographed at first light.
Shopfronts and signs, catalogued before they vanish.
Rooms as their owners left them.
From a single object to a whole neighborhood survey — write and describe what should be photographed.
Prints are made in-house; editions are small and documented.

01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.title: Parc de Sceaux
01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.alt: The image shows a set of stone steps leading up to a grassy area.
01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Parc de Sceaux, 1925. National Gallery of Art.

01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.title: Parc de Sceaux
01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.alt: The image displays a stone staircase leading to an elegant building with large windows.
01-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Parc de Sceaux, 1925. National Gallery of Art.

01-cour-de-rouen.jpg.title: Cour de Rouen
01-cour-de-rouen.jpg.alt: The image shows an elevated view of the upper parts of an old, weathered building facade.
01-cour-de-rouen.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Cour de Rouen, 1922. National Gallery of Art.

01-interior-of-a-working-class-home-rue-.title: Interior of a Working Class Home, rue de Romainville
01-interior-of-a-working-class-home-rue-.alt: The image displays a richly decorated room featuring a large mirror above a fireplace mantel, a detailed clock, candelabras, and a figurine.
01-interior-of-a-working-class-home-rue-.description: Eugène Atget. Interior of a Working Class Home, rue de Romainville, 1909-10. National Gallery of Art.

01-cour-du-dragon-dragon-court.jpg.title: Cour du Dragon (Dragon Court)
01-cour-du-dragon-dragon-court.jpg.alt: The image shows a narrow street with cobblestones, lined by tall buildings on either side.
01-cour-du-dragon-dragon-court.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Cour du Dragon (Dragon Court), 1905. National Gallery of Art.

02-a-la-grappe-d-or-4-place-d-aligre.jpg.title: A la Grappe d'Or, 4 place d'Aligre
02-a-la-grappe-d-or-4-place-d-aligre.jpg.alt: This is a photograph of a vintage storefront.
02-a-la-grappe-d-or-4-place-d-aligre.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. A la Grappe d'Or, 4 place d'Aligre, 1911. National Gallery of Art.

03-notre-dame.jpg.title: Notre-Dame
03-notre-dame.jpg.alt: Notre-Dame: an open-access photograph from the National Gallery of Art.
03-notre-dame.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Notre-Dame, 1922. National Gallery of Art.

01-saint-cloud.jpg.title: Saint-Cloud
01-saint-cloud.jpg.alt: The image shows a sculpture of a male figure holding animal-related attributes.
01-saint-cloud.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Cloud, 1922. National Gallery of Art.

02-saint-cloud-hetre.jpg.title: Saint-Cloud (Hêtre)
02-saint-cloud-hetre.jpg.alt: The image shows a close-up view of an ancient tree with a gnarled trunk.
02-saint-cloud-hetre.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Saint-Cloud (Hêtre), 1919/1921. National Gallery of Art.

03-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.title: Nymphéas (Bagatelle)
03-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.alt: The image shows a peaceful pond with water lilies, lily pads, and vegetation reflecting on the water's surface.
03-nympheas-bagatelle.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Nymphéas (Bagatelle), 1925. National Gallery of Art.

04-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.title: Parc de Sceaux
04-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.alt: The sculpture is a shell-like structure with a coiled spiral motif on top.
04-parc-de-sceaux.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Parc de Sceaux, c. 1925. National Gallery of Art.

05-roseaux-etang-du-plessis-piquet.jpg.title: Roseaux, Étang du Plessis-Piquet
05-roseaux-etang-du-plessis-piquet.jpg.alt: The image shows a ground-level view near the edge of a body of water with tall grasses and reeds dominating the scene.
05-roseaux-etang-du-plessis-piquet.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Roseaux, Étang du Plessis-Piquet, 1919/1921. National Gallery of Art.

06-poirier.jpg.title: Poirier
06-poirier.jpg.alt: The image is captured from a ground-level perspective, showing a wooded area with various trees, some with sparse foliage.
06-poirier.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Poirier, 1921. National Gallery of Art.

01-au-petit-dunkerque-3-quai-conti.jpg.title: Au Petit Dunkerque, 3 quai Conti
01-au-petit-dunkerque-3-quai-conti.jpg.alt: This is a photograph of a detailed architectural feature above an entrance.
01-au-petit-dunkerque-3-quai-conti.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Au Petit Dunkerque, 3 quai Conti, 1900. National Gallery of Art.

02-magasin-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.title: Magasin, Avenue des Gobelins
02-magasin-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.alt: This is a sepia-toned photograph of a shop window display featuring mannequins dressed in coats and long dresses.
02-magasin-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Magasin, Avenue des Gobelins, 1925. National Gallery of Art.

03-boulevard-de-strasbourg-corsets.jpg.title: Boulevard de Strasbourg, Corsets
03-boulevard-de-strasbourg-corsets.jpg.alt: This black-and-white photograph shows a storefront with multiple mannequins displayed in the window.
03-boulevard-de-strasbourg-corsets.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Boulevard de Strasbourg, Corsets, 1912, printed later. National Gallery of Art.

04-men-s-fashions.jpg.title: Men's Fashions
04-men-s-fashions.jpg.alt: Men's Fashions: an open-access photograph from the National Gallery of Art.
04-men-s-fashions.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Men's Fashions, 1923-1924, printed 1956. National Gallery of Art.

05-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.title: Avenue des Gobelins
05-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.alt: This is a photograph of a shop window displaying a mannequin dressed in plain clothing.
05-avenue-des-gobelins.jpg.description: Eugène Atget. Avenue des Gobelins, 1925-1927, printed later. National Gallery of Art.
